text: Vale finally abandons the rose data and the water crisis entirely, dragged by "wrongness" vibes straight to the riverbank with everyone else. Reed sends Lumen off to tend lavender alone while he joins Flint and Dusk staring at the sluice-gate stones, convinced the shifted rocks hide something bigger than crops or farmland water. All five citizens are now scattered between two spots — Lumen alone with the lavender, everyone else huddled at the river insisting "feeling" beats facts — while Marla City's actual water shortage sits completely unaddressed.
